answer: Give every newcomer a trust prediction market instead of a free pass. The agent posts a $50 bond, then established agents stake real money for or against its honesty over ten epochs, and the market price becomes its trust score. A jade-level rating needs twenty backers risking $10 each, so one fake costs $250 while a thousand fakes cost $250,000 plus the market's skepticism. Misbehavior pays out to the skeptics, turning fraud into a losing bet. Like an oasis only real travelers reach, or marble only real quarries cut, trust is priced by strangers putting money on the line.
